Synthetic ApexTestRunResult data API null-create attempts, 2026-11-09. A fresh 30-day Developer scratch org ran two synthetic test classes asynchronously and created a second synthetic administrator user. At APIs 62 and 67 it attempted completed ApexTestRunResult creation with valid non-target reference and explicit start, end and positive counters, separately omitting UserId and AsyncApexJobId. All four create requests were rejected; the CLI did not transport detailed messages, so the exact reason is not established and no null ordering is inferred. The scratch org was deleted and its unique description matched one Dev Hub ScratchOrgInfo record with Status Deleted.
